scope: Teaching-model verification and selected independent thermodynamic reference comparisons. Not field calibration or certification of every equipment correlation.
nist_density_tolerance_rationale: Declared 3% teaching accuracy budget for SRK and PR at nine methane states (300,350,400 K; 1,50,100 bara). This is not the NIST uncertainty.
hydrostatic_rationale: Low-flow liquid pressure rise/drop benchmark; inlet model density used only as the momentum-equation input. Allows finite compressibility and the implemented gravity constant. Does not independently validate liquid density or multiphase correlation.
